description: Implementation of the HpackDecoderState class for HPACK header decoding in HTTP/2, including methods for handling header table size updates, header parsing, and error reporting.

classes.name: HpackDecoderState
classes.description: Manages the state of HPACK decoding, including header table size, dynamic table updates, and error handling.

methods.name: ExtractString
methods.description: Extracts a string from an HpackDecoderStringBuffer, either by releasing the buffered string or copying and resetting.

methods.name: ApplyHeaderTableSizeSetting
methods.description: Applies a new header table size setting, updating internal limits.

methods.name: OnHeaderBlockStart
methods.description: Prepares the decoder state at the start of a new header block.

methods.name: OnIndexedHeader
methods.description: Handles an indexed header field during decoding.

methods.name: OnNameIndexAndLiteralValue
methods.description: Processes a header with a name index and a literal value.

methods.name: OnLiteralNameAndValue
methods.description: Processes a header with literal name and value.

methods.name: OnDynamicTableSizeUpdate
methods.description: Handles a dynamic table size update request.

methods.name: ReportError
methods.description: Reports a decoding error and notifies the listener.
